prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Medic survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the approved complete idle strip for this exact facing; it locks identity, camera and equipment grip. Image 2 is the original shipped single-facing seed. Both references show the required direction; do not invent an opposite-facing view. Preserve the same young adult woman Iona Vale with short wavy blonde hair and blue eyes under a large ivory hood, layered ragged ivory medical coat/cape, dark charcoal trousers, brown leather boots/harness, gloves, a rust-red medical satchel at the physical RIGHT hip and a small red-and-ivory vial next to it. The satchel retains its simple paired ivory bars and the upper sleeves their simple paired red bars. ONE long brass medical rifle with its red cylindrical reservoir stays in the physical RIGHT rear-trigger hand and LEFT forward-support hand. Preserve satchel side, the single rifle, reservoir, hood and face. No staff, second gun, duplicated satchel/vial, changed medical symbol, exposed hair on the back of the hood or new decorative pattern. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet color planes and selective practical contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive tiny scratches, decorative filigree or noise. Maintain two arms, two legs and one intact body/weapon in every pose.
Every pose faces WEST, screen LEFT, in the exact approved side/three-quarter angle. Nose and both boots point screen LEFT. Keep physical RIGHT hand on the rear trigger and LEFT on forward support, as the approved seed shows. Do not expose an east-facing head, reverse direction or mirror the other facing.
Draw EXACTLY EIGHT full-body poses in a roomy FOUR-column by TWO-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. One continuous grounded running cycle toward screen LEFT: 1 forward foot plants while rear heel lifts, 2 weight passes over that support, 3 rear foot swings forward beneath the body, 4 feet exchange with a short light step, 5 opposite foot plants, 6 weight passes over that support, 7 other leg swings forward, 8 return toward frame 1. Alternate the two original legs naturally; no duplicated boots, sliding static legs or unrelated stances. Every head/chest/boot stays in the SAME exact WEST facing throughout. Keep the original two-handed ready weapon hold, cap/hood, physical equipment sides, belt, satchel and short controlled coat movement. The weapon stays rigid and attached to both hands. No shooting, muzzle flash, recoil, roll, fall, airborne leap, particle, effect or ground shadow.
Use ONE shared character scale across all eight poses and one ground baseline per row. Leave at least eight percent of the canvas width clear at its outer left and right edges, and large transparent gutters between COMPLETE bodies, coats and barrels. Each full pose including its entire gun must fit wholly inside its own allotted cell with generous empty space. Draw the figures smaller rather than touching a neighbor or clipping an exterior edge. Genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside each complete pose, including between limbs. No floor, scenery, background, haze, gradient, border, grid line, label, text or number. Match the approved restrained matte ink/gouache style and original identity.
